name: @sowonai/mcp-google-drive

tools.name: gdrive_listFiles
tools.description:
Search and retrieve files from Google Drive. By default, returns the 10 most recent files. Supports full Google Drive search query syntax including non-English text searches.

- For the "query" parameter: You can use a simple keyword like "제품 기획" or "회의록", or full Google Drive query syntax like "name contains 'document'". Simple keywords will be automatically converted to proper search queries.
- Example queries: "제품 기획" (searches for this Korean text), "회의록" (searches for meeting notes), "name contains 'budget'", "mimeType='application/pdf'", "modifiedTime > '2023-01-01'"
- To search for files in Korean, simply use the Korean keyword directly as your query parameter value.

query.description: Google Drive search query. Can be a simple keyword like "제품 기획" (automatically processed) or full query syntax.

folderId.description: ID of the folder to list files from

tools.name: gdrive_getFileDetails
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific file or folder.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder to retrieve details for

tools.name: gdrive_createFolder
tools.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive.

name.description: Name of the folder to create

tools.name: gdrive_uploadFile
tools.description: Upload a file to Google Drive.

filePath.description: Path to the local file to upload

name.description: Name to give the file in Google Drive

parentId.description: ID of the parent folder in Google Drive

tools.name: gdrive_downloadFile
tools.description: Download a file from Google Drive to a local destination.

fileId.description: ID of the file to download

destinationPath.description: Local path where to save the downloaded file

tools.name: gdrive_deleteFile
tools.description: Permanently delete a file or folder from Google Drive.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder to delete

tools.name: gdrive_shareFile
tools.description: Share a file or folder with specific users or make it publicly accessible.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder to share

email.description: Email address of the user to share with

allowDiscovery.description: Whether the file can be discovered through search

message.description: Custom message to include in notification emails

tools.name: gdrive_moveFile
tools.description: Move a file or folder to a different folder in Google Drive.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder to move

keepParents.description: Whether to keep the file in its current folders
